# PHASE-002 - Deliver the constrained standards backend

| Field | Value |

| Depends on | PHASE-001 |

## Objective

Expose actual RDF/SPARQL/SHACL behavior over selected project data.

## Scope

- Worker access restrictions
- RDF datasets, provenance and interchange
- Read-only query and shape validation

## Entry conditions

- Compatible profile contract and explicit provisioning authority are available.

## Exit criteria

- All supported serialization/query/validation paths work through the constrained backend.
- Blocked external accesses and prohibited mutations are observable.

## Risks

- Parser plugins and indirect URI resolution can bypass superficial string checks.

## TASK-005 - Implement the restricted standards worker

Run selected backend operations in a supervised process with closed parser/plugin registration, trusted local inputs, OS file/network restrictions and enforced termination limits.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-009, REQ-014, REQ-032, REQ-039 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_worker.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_advanced_worker.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-003, TASK-004 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Fail closed if the required host confinement is absent; do not claim cross-host support from Darwin tests.

### Acceptance criteria

- Remote contexts/imports, external XML resources, escaping/symlink paths and unselected plugins cannot access protected resources.
- Timeout, cancellation, memory exhaustion and worker failure return distinct non-success states with bounded output.

### Planned verification

- Use sentinel files and local network listeners to observe blocked reads and attempted connections through actual parsers.
- Exercise worker termination, malformed IPC and memory-limit probes on the supported host.

## TASK-006 - Implement versioned RDF dataset projection

Project selected v1 records and approved extensions into separately identified RDF graphs with literal types, languages, module membership and exact input snapshots.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-002, REQ-005, REQ-006 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_rdf.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_rdf_dataset.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-005 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- V1 subtype/class representation requires explicit RDF mapping rather than blindly treating every record field as formal semantics.

### Acceptance criteria

- Asserted, derived, inferred and external graphs remain distinct and include only selected project inputs.
- Repeated projection of fixed inputs is semantically equivalent and leaves canonical bytes unchanged.

### Planned verification

- Compare graph memberships, typed/language literals, IDs and module versions against expected fixtures.
- Hash canonical inputs before/after materialization and deny implicit cross-project inclusion.

## TASK-007 - Add interoperable derivation provenance

Map assertions, sources and generating activities to PROV-O-compatible RDF with exact local evidence locators, hashes and freshness.

| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |

| Dependencies | TASK-006 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Do not turn a generator identity or source citation into operational authority.

### Acceptance criteria

- Source entities, activities, available producers and derivation links survive supported export.
- Stale/missing sources are visible; provenance never supplies approval or execution permission.

### Planned verification

- Trace a result through its exact source and producer activity.
- Change/remove a source fixture and verify stale/unavailable attribution.

## TASK-008 - Implement staged lossless interchange

Support selected JSON-LD, Turtle and RDF/XML import/export through restricted parsing, semantic comparison and explicit graph-context/provenance manifests.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-004, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-039 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_interchange.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_interchange.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-007 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Never flatten graph classes silently or grant trust from valid syntax.

### Acceptance criteria

- Round trips preserve supported IDs, datatypes/languages, relations and graph membership independent of ordering and blank-node labels.
- Graph-only exports select one graph with adequate manifest or reject lossless conversion; imports stage conflicts and unsupported constructs as proposals.
- Export destinations and overwrite behavior are explicit; imports never publish canonical content.

### Planned verification

- Run dataset and graph-manifest round trips for all three formats including blank-node renaming.
- Test namespace conflicts, unsupported constructs, unselected destinations and protected canonical hashes.

## TASK-009 - Expose bounded read-only SPARQL

Implement CLI/API SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT and DESCRIBE with explicit graph selection and deterministic normalization where applicable.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-008, REQ-009, REQ-039 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_sparql.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_sparql.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-007 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Do not rely on literal keyword matching or persistent graph-producing query output.

### Acceptance criteria

- Each query form returns the correct result type with dataset/project/profile versions and graph scope.
- Parsed updates and SERVICE are rejected; FROM/FROM NAMED resolve only preloaded permitted graphs without resource retrieval.
- DESCRIBE policy, ordering, nondeterministic expressions and partial/limited results are documented; queries write no persistent state.

### Planned verification

- Run actual four-form queries and explicit graph-selection fixtures.
- Use mutation sentinels and network/file probes for updates, federation, malformed/cancelled/limited requests and freshness.

## TASK-010 - Deliver real graph-constraint validation

Provide manifested SHACL shapes and pySHACL adapters covering supported definitions, provenance, references, endpoint types and cardinalities.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-004, REQ-010, REQ-017, REQ-039 |

| Target artifacts | ONTOLOGY-depo/shapes/ontology-v1.ttl, SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_shacl.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_shacl.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-007 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A backend exception or unavailable validator must never count as conformance.

### Acceptance criteria

- Reports distinguish conformant, violation, unsupported feature and processing failure with entity/path/shape/severity details.
- Core/SHACL overlap agrees; graph scope and inference mode are explicit; inferred triples cannot fill missing approval or source evidence.

### Planned verification

- Run actual pySHACL conforming, violating, malformed-shape and unsupported-extension cases.
- Compare overlapping core and shape checks and verify JS/import/custom-function restrictions.
